empleos.descripcion: ABOUT INTRIQ Intriq turns a client's disorganised data room into deal-ready insight. We build the platform that lets accounting and audit teams process financial documents at machine speed without losing the rigour a human review demands. Every output is derived solely from the client's own data, nothing external. THE ROLE You will build the platform that does it, from the React workspace auditors touch every day, down through the async Python pipelines that read and reason over financial documents. You will work across three repositories: QNextDash (frontend), QInsights (API and pipeline backend) and QCLI (internal tooling), shipping features end to end rather than staying on one side of a spec. This is not a maintenance role. You will be one of the first engineers shaping how the async document pipeline, the API contracts and the infrastructure scale as we take on larger clients and heavier document volumes. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO • Build across the stack. A Next.js workspace view one week, the FastAPI endpoint and Postgres schema behind it the next. • Design and harden async workflows: document ingestion, markdown conversion, LLM-based extraction and multi-step review pipelines that stay correct under concurrency and partial failure. • Own services from Terraform up. Provision the Fargate task or Lambda, wire the CI/CD pipeline, and watch it in CloudWatch once it is live. • Work directly with data. Shape Postgres schemas, write the queries behind reporting and audit trails, and keep every pipeline output traceable back to its source document. • Make architecture calls with the founding team. At this size, the person who writes the code decides how it is structured. THE STACK Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand, Tailwind API and pipe
